denial_type_rationale: CO-29 timely filing denial; the dispute is about proof of the original submission, not clinical merit.
reasons_for: The original claim was transmitted 6 days after surgery (batch RB-0617-02) and accepted by the clearinghouse the next day.
The billing memo notes other Harborview claims from the same week were also delayed, suggesting a payer-connection problem; Manual 7.6 allows waivers for payer outages.
The procedure was prior-authorized (HHP-AUTH-662190), so medical necessity is not in question.
reasons_against: Manual 7.4 explicitly says a 999 or clearinghouse-level acceptance alone is NOT sufficient proof.
No 277CA or Harborview claim number for the original submission has been located.
The outage theory is unverified; the ClearPath payer-connection report has not been pulled.
recommended_strategy: Before appealing, pull the ClearPath payer-connection report for batch RB-0617-02 and any outage notices. If it shows Harborview accepted the claim, the case becomes strong under 7.4(b). Otherwise, request a 7.6 outage waiver with evidence from the other delayed claims.
